# Shibumi Shell 0.1.1-beta.7

This prerelease removes a Network label binding loop without changing the established V1 or V2 visual design.

Update an existing source installation:

```bash
cd Shibumi-Shell
git pull --ff-only
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes
```

> AUR publication remains pending because registration is currently unavailable.

## What changed

- Measure bounded Network labels independently from their rendered width
- Exercise Wi-Fi transitions across V1 and V2 full, icon, and text modes, including long bounded labels
- Repeatedly validate V1, V2, and stock Omarchy bar transitions

## Fixes in beta.7

- Prevent the V2 Wi-Fi label from entering a `width`/`implicitWidth` binding loop
- Remove the same cyclic width pattern from the shared V1/V2 text-only Network presentation

## Compatibility and release limits

- The suite remains 24 native Omarchy plugins in one Quickshell process
- No colors, typography, icons, animation, or intended label-width limits changed
- Physical mixed-scale multi-monitor, enterprise Wi-Fi, remaining device-backed Bluetooth, and clean-chroot package checks remain explicit external stable gates

Full Changelog: [`v0.1.1-beta.6...v0.1.1-beta.7`](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.1.1-beta.6...v0.1.1-beta.7)
